name: HILLSEAT-1-no-pad
note: the pads never built: TEMPASH3's houses hang up to 2.2 m over the median's slope again

name: HILLSEAT-2-footprint-middle
new:
const h0 = hullXZ(pts), mx = h0.reduce((s, q) => s + q[0], 0) / h0.length, mz = h0.reduce((s, q) => s + q[1], 0) / h0.length;
  return { base, hull: h0.map(([x, z]) => [mx + (x - mx) / 2, mz + (z - mz) / 2]) };
note: the footprint shrunk to its middle half (what fb1005_hills sampled): the walls' edges hang over the bank

name: HILLSEAT-3-tolerance-widened
note: a 0.6 m bar: the pad's top a fifth of a metre under the base, and the houses' edges 0.2 m over it

name: HILLSEAT-4-world-not-drawn
note: the streaming host builds the pads and never draws them

name: HILLSEAT-5-world-not-solid
old: addStatic(hillPatch, originMatrix, false); collider.addMesh(key, hillPatch.positions, hillPatch.indices, originMatrix, onFloatingFrame(host.state, ((o) => () => host.state.pixelTranslation(px, py, o))([0, 0, 0])));
note: drawn but not solid: the player falls through the bank onto the hill's slope

name: HILLSEAT-6-world-own-upload
new: if (hillPatch) { models.push({ gpu: renderer.createMesh(hillPatch), local: originMatrix, _box: transformedAabb(localAabb(hillPatch.positions), originMatrix), _order: -2 });
note: the pads uploaded as a GPU mesh of their own, which destroyPixel never frees (a pixel's models are the pipeline's shared meshes)

name: HILLSEAT-7-teardown-keeps-the-batch
note: destroyPixel drops the batch the pads ride without freeing it

name: HILLSEAT-8-exterior-not-drawn
old: if (hillPatch) { drawList.push({ mesh: renderer.createMesh(hillPatch), matrix: originMatrix, order: -2, box: transformedAabb(localAabb(hillPatch.positions), originMatrix) });
note: the fixed city builds the pads and never draws them

name: HILLSEAT-9-seat-not-laid

name: HILLSEAT-13-held-padded
old: if (base - high > HILL_SEAT_STAND || gap <= HILL_PATCH_SINK) continue;

name: HILLSEAT-14-crossings-missed
old: if (s >= 0 && s <= 1 && u >= 0 && u <= 1) out.push([px + rx * s, pz + rz * s]);
